title: Completeness of the canonical decision tree
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a nonempty set, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\alpha$ be a function. The decision tree that queries all coordinates in order and returns $f(x)$ at the leaf corresponding to input $x$ computes $f$ on every input.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from $n$-coordinate inputs over $\Omega$ to $\alpha$
